<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Part 5/5 of the DeepSeek-V4.1 CP>1 support series, split from the original combined PR [#45954](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45954). Based on the CP replay core in part 3. This PR adds Mooncake Store L3 recovery independently of the P/D extension.

For replay recovery, taking the minimum reported hit length is insufficient when required pools are restorable only at specific endpoints. All peers must adopt a common restorable endpoint. Stored KV also needs a producer namespace: identical model/token keys do not establish numerical compatibility across different CP topologies or compute recipes.

For example, suppose two peers report restorable page endpoints `{1, 3}` and `{1, 2}`. Taking the minimum of their maximum hit lengths yields page 2, which the first peer cannot restore. Intersecting the endpoint sets instead yields page 1. This illustrates endpoint selection, not a new Mooncake/RDMA measurement.

## Modifications

- Propagate backend restorable endpoints and intersect them across peers before adoption, alongside the common hit bound and per-pool results.
- Keep scheduler probes and background prefetch on their respective collective groups. Use matching collective sequences for hits, misses, query failures, and cancellation.
- Add a storage namespace derived from KV layout and the CP producer recipe, including topology, selected compute backends, relevant options, and package versions. Preserve a user-supplied `extra_backend_tag`.
- Require Mooncake Store for this CP replay L3 path, including runtime attachment. Preserve CP1 cache identity.

Changing CP topology or a recorded numerical recipe changes the namespace. Changing pool capacity alone does not. Autotune tactics must still be pinned; rotate `extra_backend_tag` and warm the cache when unrecorded tactic choices change.

Only persistent cache pools are stored. Request windows, draft rings, and hidden state are rebuilt or transferred through their existing paths. P/D still requires part 4; direct L3 linking and `buffer_only` remain outside this scope.

## Accuracy Tests

Archived replay/storage CPU validation for this split head: **55 passed, 0 skipped**. Coverage includes producer tags, runtime attachment, endpoint propagation, and two-rank Gloo restore collectives. Lint passed during split preparation.

The endpoint regression supplies the trailing-pool query plan and mocks hash/transport boundaries. It does not prove automatic plan discovery, production hashing, real Mooncake Store/RDMA, or GPU L3-to-L1 bitwise equivalence. Historical combined H20 results are not standalone acceptance for this head.

+"""Persistent cache identities for CP encoder replay producers."""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+
+
+def replay_storage_tag(pool, *, producer):
+    """Identity for CP>1 producers; CP1 never calls this function.
+
+    The supported pools are replicated across CP; existing component keys and
+    the single-writer policy address them. Request windows, draft rings, hidden
+    states, and pool capacities are not persisted. Cross-CP-size sharing is not
+    assumed when native numerical schedules differ.
+    """
+    layout = {
+        "version": 1,
+        "execution": "upstream-folded-extend-cp-v1",
+        "producer": producer,
+        "kv_layout": pool.kv_layout.value,
+        "compressed_kv_layouts": [
+            [r, pool.compressed_kv_layout(r).value]
+            for r in sorted(set(pool.compression_ratios) - {0})
+        ],
+        "page_size": pool.page_size,
+        "compression_ratios": list(pool.compression_ratios),
+        "kv_sources": list(pool.kv_source_layers),
+    }
+    payload = json.dumps(
+        layout, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False
+    ).encode()
+    return "dsv41-cp-replay-v1-" + hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()[:24]
+
+
+def runtime_replay_producer():
+    """Snapshot the target recipe once during CP cache construction."""
+    import importlib.metadata
+
+    import torch
+
+    from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.utils import get_moe_a2a_backend, get_moe_runner_backend
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils import get_fp8_gemm_runner_backend
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec, get_parallel, process_model_config
+
+    parallel, model = get_parallel(), process_model_config()
+    device = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(torch.cuda.current_device())
+    versions = {}
+    for package in ("torch", "sglang-kernel", "flashinfer-python", "sgl-deep-gemm"):
+        try:
+            versions[package] = importlib.metadata.version(package)
+        except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
+            versions[package] = None
+    return {
+        "device": [
+            device.name,
+            device.major,
+            device.minor,
+            device.multi_processor_count,
+        ],
+        "parallel": {
+            name: getattr(parallel, name)
+            for name in (
+                "tp_size",
+                "ep_size",
+                "pp_size",
+                "dp_size",
+                "attn_dp_size",
+                "attn_cp_size",
+                "attn_tp_size",
+                "cp_strategy",
+            )
+        },
+        "fp8_gemm": get_fp8_gemm_runner_backend().value,
+        "moe_runner": get_moe_runner_backend().value,
+        "moe_a2a": get_moe_a2a_backend().value,
+        "moe_precision": get_exec().moe.flashinfer_mxfp4_moe_precision,
+        "dtype": str(model.dtype),
+        "quantization": model.quantization,
+        "hf_quant_config": model.hf_quant_config,
+        "versions": versions,
+        "options": {
+            name: getattr(envs, name).get()
+            for name in (
+                "SGLANG_OPT_HOPPER_BLOCK_FP8_BF16",
+                "SGLANG_DSV4_DENSE_MXSCALE",
+                "SGLANG_DSV4_DENSE_MXSCALE_SHAPES",
+                "SGLANG_DSV4_USE_BF16_KV_QUANT_SOURCE",
+                "SGLANG_DSV41_FUSED_WO_A",
+                "SGLANG_OPT_FP8_WO_A_GEMM",
+                "SGLANG_OPT_FP8_WO_A_FUSED_INVROPE",
+                "SGLANG_OPT_FUSE_WQA_WKV",
+                "SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MOE_FUSED_FINALIZE",
+                "SGLANG_OPT_USE_FLASHINFER_MHC",
+                "SGLANG_OPT_USE_TILELANG_MHC_PRE",
+                "SGLANG_OPT_USE_TILELANG_MHC_POST",
+                "SGLANG_OPT_FUSE_MHC_POST_PRE",
+                "SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_HC_PRENORM",
+                "SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_MEGA_MHC_PREFILL",
+            )
+        },
+    }

@@ -309,6 +309,10 @@ def attach_storage_backend(
         storage_backend_extra_config: Optional[dict] = None,
